entries.title: Colored Dye in a 3D Glass Tank
entries.description: A transparent box of “water” with small colored dye spheres injected from one corner that slowly spread, mix, and form swirling trails as they are pushed by a gentle, visible velocity field represented by moving arrows.

entries.title: Laminar vs Turbulent Pipe Flow
entries.description: A long transparent cylinder with particles of two colors entering from one end, first flowing in straight layers (laminar) then transitioning to swirling, colliding turbulent motion as flow speed increases, with a side graph showing flow rate and Reynolds number.

entries.title: River Bend and Erosion
entries.description: A winding 3D river channel through a sandy terrain block where blue particles flow along the curved path, eroding and carrying away brown “sediment” spheres that detach from the banks and settle in slower zones, gradually reshaping the riverbed.

entries.title: Blood Flow Through a Branching Artery
entries.description: A semi-transparent branching tube (artery) where red and white particles (blood cells) pulse forward with each heartbeat, collide gently with walls, and split at each branch, with labels showing pressure and flow speed that change in real time.

entries.title: Smoke Plume Rising in Still Air
entries.description: A small burner on the floor emits gray semi-transparent particle clouds that rise, expand, and slowly mix with the surrounding clear air box, with a faint upward velocity field and temperature-colored particles shifting from red (hot) to blue (cool) as they rise.

entries.title: Ocean Currents Around an Island
entries.description: A large shallow water plane with a central island obstacle where blue flow arrows and neutral tracer particles wrap around the island, detach into swirling vortices in the wake, and gradually mix to form visible spiral patterns.

entries.title: Ink Mixing in a Rotating Cylinder
entries.description: A transparent vertical cylinder partially filled with clear fluid where a central rod slowly rotates, dragging in streaks of colored ink droplets that stretch, fold, and wrap into intricate patterns, with trails that fade over time.

entries.title: Ventilation in a Room with Windows and a Fan
